verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover each element of the story. Invoices can be created from templates or with the AI generator (docs-11, docs-12). Online payments are enabled through a pay button added to the invoice (docs-17). Founders know when an invoice is viewed and get notified when it is paid (docs-14), and paid invoices are recorded and matched automatically (docs-1). Automated reminders add follow-up on late payments (docs-15). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the viewed/paid tracking and online payment flow, since all evidence is vendor marketing.
